entry_segment.definition: ages 16-24 (finscope_segments.lifecycle_stage == 'entry'); out-of-fold propensities of the primary model

targeting_multiplier.definition: mean predicted propensity of the top-scored share of the Entry population / mean predicted propensity of the whole Entry population (weighted)

entry_calibration.note: levels are recalibrated within the Entry band (intercept shift on the logit scale), so the mean prediction equals the observed rate; the ranking, and therefore the multiplier, is essentially unchanged

targeting_multiplier.observed_note: ratio of observed TIN rates in the top decile and overall; Entry has only 14 TIN holders, so it is low precision
targeting_multiplier.previous_definition: synthetic model: 101 targeted vs 52 random registrations from 500 messages (top 10% of a 5,000-person synthetic sample)

scoring_card.label: COMPUTED; observational, cross-sectional prediction model; scores rank adults by likeness to TIN holders, not causal
scoring_card.fit: L2-regularised logistic regression, C = 1, survey-weighted, all adults
scoring_card.age_centering: age is entered as (age - 40) / 10; the dashboard computes the same transformation

calibration_by_age_band.method: intercept shift on the logit scale per age band so that the weighted mean out-of-fold prediction equals the observed weighted TIN rate of the band; the ranking within a band is unchanged

variants.note: same outcome, population, stratified split, repeated-CV design, seeds and metrics as the survey model; features limited to what TRA holds or could obtain
